'''Dakk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked as the [[armorsmith]] for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord [[Borvo]] in the city of [[Kaadara]] on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] brought him pieces of the carapace of [[Borvo's acklay]] that the spacer had killed. Using fur from Mountain [[tusk cat]]s, [[Peko-peko/Legends|Peko-peko]] feathers and hide from feral [[shaupaut]]s provided by the spacer, Dakk built a full suit of [[Acklay armor]] for him.<ref name="SWG:FaA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dakk appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FaA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dakk was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
